heading: Refund Policy
paragraphs: SEO Group Buy offers a 48-hour money-back guarantee on eligible purchases. If your group buy tools do not work as described, request a full refund within 48 hours of purchase.
Refund requests should include your order details and a brief explanation of the issue. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method.
After 48 hours, refunds are handled case-by-case for verified service interruptions. Contact support@seogroupbuy.in to start a request.
